title: A computational approach to discover antioxidant and anti-inflammatory attributes of silymarin derived from Silybum marianum by comparison with hydroxytyrosol.
authors: Verma, Annu; Jakhar, Ritu; Kumar, Dev; Kumar, Vijay; Dhillon, Twinkle; Dangi, Mehak; Chhillar, Anil Kumar
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接和动力学模拟比较水飞蓟素与抗氧化剂对IKK、Keap-1和Tfam蛋白的结合亲和力，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作，但对象为小分子-蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且Tfam为转录因子但未研究其DNA结合，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Medicinal plants possess therapeutic potential for reducing reactive oxygen species (ROS)-mediated cellular damage. Hydroxytyrosol is one of the most potent antioxidants that served as control in the current study, including other synthetic antioxidants to computationally identify the antioxidant properties of Silymarin. The sequences of the receptors IkappaB kinase (IKK), Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (Keap-1) and mitochondrial transcription factor A (Tfam) were retrieved from UniProtKB and homology modeling was performed using Swiss-Model server. Thereof the molecular docking and dynamic simulation studies were performed using Schrodinger's software version 11.5. From the current study, it was reported that on comparison of the binding energy of silymarin, hydroxytyrosol, alpha-tocopherol, ascorbic acid, butylated hydroxy anisole (BHA) and butylated hydroxytoluene (BHT), Silymarin exhibited better affinities with IKK receptor followed by Hydroxytyrosol suggesting it as the best or comparable of all other known antioxidants that could potentially suppress inflammation and other diseases. Also, Silymarin exhibited poorest binding affinity with Tfam promoting mitochondrial biogenesis, thereby scavenging ROS. However, with Keap-1, Silymarin is ranked 4(th) in the list, whereas hydroxytyrosol exhibited highest binding affinity to release oxidative stress. The stability of docked complexes made us conclude that Silymarin has comparable antioxidant properties to hydroxytyrosol, better anti-inflammatory potential and mitochondrial biogenesis enhancing properties to ultimately reduce oxidative stress. Now it can be tested further for in vitro or in vivo studies as potential drug against oxidative insult.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 药用植物具有减少活性氧（ROS）介导的细胞损伤的治疗潜力。羟基酪醇是本研究中最有效的抗氧化剂之一，作为对照，同时包括其他合成抗氧化剂，以通过计算方式鉴定水飞蓟素的抗氧化特性。从UniProtKB中检索了IkappaB激酶（IKK）、Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（Keap-1）和线粒体转录因子A（Tfam）受体的序列，并使用Swiss-Model服务器进行了同源建模。随后，使用Schrodinger软件版本11.5进行了分子对接和动态模拟研究。本研究发现，通过比较水飞蓟素、羟基酪醇、α-生育酚、抗坏血酸、丁基羟基茴香醚（BHA）和丁基羟基甲苯（BHT）的结合能，水飞蓟素对IKK受体表现出更好的亲和力，其次是羟基酪醇，这表明水飞蓟素是已知抗氧化剂中最佳或相当的，可能有效抑制炎症及其他疾病。此外，水飞蓟素对Tfam表现出最差的结合亲和力，从而促进线粒体生物发生，进而清除ROS。然而，对于Keap-1，水飞蓟素在列表中排名第四，而羟基酪醇表现出最高的结合亲和力以释放氧化应激。对接复合物的稳定性使我们得出结论，水飞蓟素具有与羟基酪醇相当的抗氧化特性、更好的抗炎潜力以及增强线粒体生物发生的特性，最终减少氧化应激。现在可以进一步进行体外或体内研究，作为对抗氧化损伤的潜在药物。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
